sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners leading the $90bn weekly sell-off. Gold weak ('gold schmould'). Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength via cap raises.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure. Gold miners (NVA.AX, GWN.AX) underperform. Small-cap explorers attract speculative flows but cap-raise dilution risk is elevated.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears pressure valuations. ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts signals ongoing cost discipline but execution risk. RBA rental inflation concern may delay cuts.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure if RBA holds higher for longer. Credit growth may slow with housing correction. Superannuation debate adds policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Mixed-positive. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails, lifting fuel prices 30c. Australia softens gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos.AX preservation noted as strategic priority.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, AGL.AX benefit from gas policy flexibility. Higher oil supports upstream but pressures downstream and transport costs.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.WSW price-freeze breach erodes trust. Housing crash boosts first-home buyers but broader consumer confidence weak. Businesses 'fear for their future.'
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WSW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. REITs (GPG.AX, SPG.AX) pressured by rental inflation and occupancy concerns.

sectors.trend: Neutral-positive. Global pharma active (Novo Nordisk, BioMarin, Teva, Merck). AI security (Zscaler) and AI pivot (eGain) themes gaining traction. CSL.AX relatively insulated.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive exposure. ASX tech names limited but AI/security theme relevant for global-linked positions.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing prices crashing, no auction spring bounce. RBA rental inflation concern. Property chiefs calling for more migrants to address supply gap.
sectors.implications: GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICOL.AX face headwinds. Residential REITs pressured; commercial may stabilise if rates peak.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend weakness as rate-hike fears, iron ore weakness, and AUD depreciation persist. Oil spike supports energy but broad market under pressure. RBA rental inflation commentary may trigger further volatility. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points for quality property and first-home buyer plays. Energy policy flexibility supports Santos/Woodside. Superannuation system remains structurally sound despite populist noise. Iron ore recovery uncertain; diversification into gold and critical minerals (battery tech) offers optionality.
